components.product: LEGO Education Mindstorms EV3 Core Set 45544

components.name: LEGO Education EV3 Ultrasonic Sensor on the Driving Base's bracket
components.description: The EV3 Ultrasonic Sensor on the bracket LEGO Education's instructions build for it, which goes on the EV3 Driving Base (lego_45544_driving_base_chassis) at its front_sensor seat: low at the front, looking forward. components.product: LEGO Education Mindstorms EV3 Core Set 45544

components.name: LEGO Education SPIKE Prime Distance Sensor on the Driving Base's beam
components.description: The SPIKE Prime Distance Sensor (LEGO Technic 45604) on the beam LEGO Education's instructions build for it, which goes on the SPIKE Prime Driving Base (lego_45678_driving_base_chassis) at its top_front seat: upright on the hub's front end, looking forward. components.product: LEGO Education SPIKE Prime Set 45678

components.product: LEGO Technic 42095 Remote-Controlled Stunt Racer

components.name: LEGO Technic 42095 track, right: 30 reinforced chain tread links (88323) around a 14-tooth and a 10-tooth sprocket

components.product: LEGO Technic 42095 Remote-Controlled Stunt Racer

components.name: LEGO Power Functions L-Motor
components.description: LEGO Power Functions L-Motor, as LDraw draws it (99499.dat). It drives a wheel, a track or an axle it is geared to; at 9 V it turns 390 rpm unloaded and stalls at 18 N cm and 1.3 A, as Philippe Hurbain measured.
components.product: LEGO Technic 42095 Remote-Controlled Stunt Racer

components.name: LEGO Technic 42065 RC Tracked Racer, without its tracks
components.description: LEGO Technic 42065, the RC Tracked Racer, as its instructions build it: a Power Functions battery box and infrared receiver on a body that runs on two tracks, each turned by a Power Functions M motor on the axle of one of its sprockets, the left track's rear one and the right track's front one, with no gears between; it steers by the difference of their speeds. Two track mounts at the driven sprockets' hubs, a seat on the body's top, and a seat for each motor, whose driveline turns its track one to one.
components.product: LEGO Technic 42065 RC Tracked Racer

components.name: LEGO Technic 42065 track, left: 37 wide tread links (57518) around two 10-tooth sprockets and six road wheels
components.description: The left track of LEGO Technic 42065 as its model builds it: 37 wide tread links (57518), 38.4 mm wide, around two 10-tooth sprockets (57519) 160 mm apart, both clear of the ground, and six road wheels (4185), its run on the ground under the road wheels; the motor turns its rear sprocket, and the belt travels 120 mm per turn of it.
components.product: LEGO Technic 42065 RC Tracked Racer

components.product: LEGO Technic 42065 RC Tracked Racer

components.name: LEGO Power Functions M-Motor
components.description: LEGO Power Functions M-Motor, as LDraw draws it (58120.dat). It drives a wheel, a track or an axle it is geared to; at 9 V it turns 405 rpm unloaded and stalls at 11 N cm and 850 mA, as Philippe Hurbain measured.
components.product: LEGO Technic 42065 RC Tracked Racer

components.name: LEGO Education EV3 Touch Sensor on the Driving Base's left arm
components.description: The EV3 Touch Sensor on the bracket LEGO Education's instructions build for it, which goes on the EV3 Driving Base (lego_45544_driving_base_chassis) at its left_arm seat: low in front of the left wheel, its red button forward. It tells whether its button is pressed. The bracket is a black liftarm 3 x 0.5 and a black beam 2 on an axle 3 through the rail under the sensor's back; the left white arm's axle 4 goes through the liftarm, the rail and the beam.
components.product: LEGO Education Mindstorms EV3 Core Set 45544

components.name: 120:1 Mini Plastic Gearmotor HP, Offset 3mm D-Shaft Output, Extended Motor Shaft
components.description: Pololu 120:1 Mini Plastic Gearmotor HP with an offset 3 mm D-shaft output and an extended motor shaft, the motor of the Romi chassis kit. At 4.5 V it turns 150 rpm unloaded and stalls at 25 oz in (0.18 N m) and 1.25 A; a clutch in its gearbox slips near that load.

components.name: Motor Driver and Power Distribution Board for Romi Chassis
components.description: Pololu Motor Driver and Power Distribution Board for the Romi chassis: two DRV8838 motor drivers, 1.8 A a channel on a 2.5 V to 10.8 V supply, with the Romi's power switch, reverse protection and a 5 V or 3.3 V regulator. It lies on the Romi's deck and solders to its battery contacts.

components.name: Romi 32U4 Control Board
components.description: Pololu Romi 32U4 Control Board: an ATmega32U4 controller with two DRV8838 motor drivers, 1.8 A a channel on a 2.5 V to 10.8 V supply, the Romi's power switch, a 5 V regulator, an accelerometer and gyro, and connections for encoders and a Raspberry Pi. It lies on the Romi's deck and solders to its battery contacts.

components.name: Rechargeable NiMH AA Battery: 1.2 V, 2200 mAh, six cells for the Romi chassis
components.description: Six of Pololu's rechargeable NiMH AA cells, 1.2 V and 2200 mAh each, as the Romi chassis holds them in its battery compartment: two between the motors and four behind them, 7.2 V in series. The cells are sold one at a time; this part is the six a Romi takes.

components.name: 30:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor MP 6V with Extended Motor Shaft
components.description: Pololu 30:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor MP 6V with an extended motor shaft, the motor of the Standard Edition 3pi+ robots: a brushed motor 10 x 12 mm in section with a metal gearbox between brass plates and a 3 mm D-shaft output. At 6 V it turns 720 rpm unloaded and stalls at 0.33 kg cm (0.032 N m) and 0.67 A.

components.name: 75:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor LP 6V with Extended Motor Shaft
components.description: Pololu 75:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor LP 6V with an extended motor shaft, the motor of the Turtle Edition 3pi+ robots: a brushed motor 10 x 12 mm in section with a metal gearbox between brass plates and a 3 mm D-shaft output. At 6 V it turns 180 rpm unloaded and stalls at 0.64 kg cm (0.063 N m) and 0.36 A.

components.name: 15:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor HPCB 6V with Extended Motor Shaft
components.description: Pololu 15:1 Micro Metal Gearmotor HPCB 6V with an extended motor shaft, the motor of the Hyper Edition 3pi+ robots: a brushed motor with carbon brushes, 10 x 12 mm in section, with a metal gearbox between brass plates and a 3 mm D-shaft output. At 6 V it turns 2100 rpm unloaded and stalls at 0.25 kg cm (0.025 N m) and 1.5 A.

components.name: 3pi+ 2040 Control Board
components.description: Pololu 3pi+ 2040 Control Board: an RP2040 controller with two DRV8838 motor drivers, 1.8 A a channel, on a 2.7 V to 8.5 V supply that a regulator on it turns into a constant 8 V for the motors; with five line sensors, two bump sensors, an IMU, sensors for the motors' encoders, buttons, RGB LEDs and a buzzer. It screws onto a 3pi+ chassis and solders to its battery contacts. Sold without the OLED display it has a header for.

components.name: 3pi+ 32U4 OLED Control Board
components.description: Pololu 3pi+ 32U4 OLED Control Board: an ATmega32U4 controller with two DRV8838 motor drivers, 1.8 A a channel, on a 2.7 V to 6.5 V supply that a regulator on it turns into a constant 8 V for the motors; with five line sensors, two bump sensors, an IMU, sensors for the motors' encoders, buttons and a buzzer. It screws onto a 3pi+ chassis and solders to its battery contacts. Sold without the OLED display it has a header for.

components.name: 3pi+ 32U4 Control Board
components.description: Pololu 3pi+ 32U4 Control Board, the board of the original 3pi+ 32U4 robot with an LCD: an ATmega32U4 controller with two DRV8838 motor drivers, 1.8 A a channel, on a 2.7 V to 6.5 V supply that a regulator on it turns into a constant 8 V for the motors; with five line sensors, two bump sensors, an IMU, sensors for the motors' encoders, buttons and a buzzer. It screws onto a 3pi+ chassis and solders to its battery contacts. Sold without the 8x2 character LCD it has a header for.

components.name: Rechargeable NiMH AAA Battery: 1.2 V, 900 mAh, four cells for a 3pi+ chassis
components.description: Four of Pololu's rechargeable NiMH AAA cells, 1.2 V and 900 mAh each, as a 3pi+ chassis holds them under its control board: two in front of the motors and two behind them, 4.8 V in series. The cells are sold one at a time; this part is the four a 3pi+ takes.

components.name: Graphical OLED Display: 128x64, 1.3", White Pixels, SPI, Black PCB
components.description: The black-PCB 128 x 64 graphical OLED supplied with the 3pi+ 2040 and current 3pi+ 32U4 OLED robots. Represented as a passive Attachment with its fitted low-profile header; no display commands are simulated. It mounts on its control board, not on the bare chassis.

components.name: 8×2 Character LCD - Black Bezel (Parallel Interface)
components.description: The 8 x 2 character LCD with black bezel supplied with the original 3pi+ 32U4 robots. Represented as a passive Attachment with its fitted low-profile header; no display commands are simulated. It mounts on its control board, not on the bare chassis.

components.name: 520 encoder gearmotor, 90:1, 12 V
components.description: Hiwonder JGB37-520R90-12 brushed encoder gearmotor: 37 mm gearbox, 6 mm eccentric D-shaft and a protected magnetic encoder. The 90:1 motor is rated at 12 V, 110 rpm unloaded, 15 kg cm stalled and 3.2 A stall current. Taken from the official Ackermann chassis CAD whose motor specification matches this sold-alone variant.
components.product: JGB37-520R90-12 encoder gearmotor, single

components.name: Hiwonder robot battery pack, 11.1 V 6000 mAh
components.description: The shared 11.1 V, 6 Ah wrapped lithium battery shown for the ROSOrin Standard and Advanced kits, JetAuto, JetAcker and both JetRover chassis kits, drawn from their matching official body dimensions and photographs with the printed label, folded wrapping, leads, SM connector and DC charging socket. Its original ROSOrin product provenance is retained; each host records the supplied pack in includes, so using it in that kit does not add a separate purchase.
components.product: ROSOrin Standard Kit, without controller

components.name: Hiwonder MentorPi and LanderPi battery pack, 7.4 V 2200 mAh
components.description: The shared 7.4 V, 2.2 Ah wrapped lithium battery shown for MentorPi M1 and A1 and both LanderPi chassis kits, drawn from the identical official size and photograph with the printed label, folded wrapping, leads, SM connector and DC charging socket. Its original M1 Standard kit provenance is retained; all four hosts record the supplied pack in includes.
components.product: MentorPi M1 Standard, without Raspberry Pi 5

components.name: L-type 520 encoder gearmotor, 12 V, 40:1
components.description: Yahboom L-type 520 encoder gearmotor with its 6 mm D output shaft offset from a brushed motor, a 40:1 metal gearbox, a rear Hall encoder board and a six-pin socket. Its four M3 gearbox mounting holes fit the brackets supplied with Yahboom's aluminium alloy chassis kits; the brackets and couplings are not included in this Separate motor variant.
components.product: L-type 520 Encoder DC Reduction Motor (Separate motor)

components.name: 7.4 V 2000 mAh lithium battery pack
components.description: Yahboom two-cell lithium battery pack supplied with the Raspbot V2, MicroROS-Pi5 and ESP32 MicroROS kits, with a blue sleeve, white 7.4 V 2000 mAh label, red T discharge plug and black charging socket. The three kits' own charging manuals state matching dimensions, mass and electrical ratings. It is priced as the Raspbot V2 kit that supplies it; each of the three chassis purchases includes one. No standalone battery listing is asserted.
components.product: Raspbot V2 robot car, Standard kit without the Raspberry Pi

components.name: 520 encoder gearmotor, 90:1, JetAuto and JetAcker description geometry
components.description: The 12 V 90:1 520 encoder gearmotor supplied in Hiwonder JetAuto and JetAcker kits, represented by the older or simplified geometry in their official robot descriptions. Its metal housing and shaft share the same geometry in both descriptions; the JetAcker version also draws its encoder pieces. The electrical ratings map the kits' published 12 V, 90:1 and 15 kg cm conditions to the current R90 specification table by inference; they are not measurements of the legacy CAD revision, whose identity remains unconfirmed.
components.product: JetAcker Standard Kit, without controller

components.name: ClawPi 7.4 V 2200 mAh battery pack
